title: How reps get [involved]{.secondary-alt}
description: Every rep has a path to join an OSS trip. Here is how it works.

events.title: Express interest
events.description: Tell us you want to serve. Sign-ups open before each trip.

events.title: Get selected
events.description: We confirm the team based on [TO CONFIRM: qualification criteria].

events.title: Prepare together
events.description: Meet your team, learn about the community you will serve and get everything you need ready.

events.title: Travel and serve
events.description: Spend the week building, donating and volunteering side by side with the community.

events.title: Bring it home
events.description: Share what you saw with the team, and help plan the next trip.
